randomized_domain.draw: random.Random(scoring_master_seed) (Python, input generation only; both implementations consume the same committed case file). Per case: n = rng.randint(1, 6) elements; each element: u = rng.random(); u < 0.45 -> text(); u < 0.90 -> record(); else rng.choice(REGISTERED_SCALARS). text(): k = rng.randint(1, 4) tokens rng.choice(TOKENS) joined by rng.choice(SEPARATORS) each, then with probability 0.2 .upper(), 0.2 .lower(), else unchanged. record(): for each key of ['id', 'name', 'kind', 'line', 'slot', 'booking', 'state', 'in_line', 'kg'] included with probability 0.4: id / name / line / slot -> text() (name: with probability 0.1 rng.choice(REGISTERED_SCALARS) instead); kind -> rng.choice(['mass_line', 'c1_branch', 'power_slot', 'floor_constituent', text()]); booking -> rng.choice(['CONDITIONAL_NOT_BOOKED', 'EMBEDDED_IN_FLOOR', 'DECLARED_ABSENT', 'NONE', text()]); state -> rng.choice(['NO_C1_XE_BRANCH_IN_FLIGHT', 'no_c1 hardware', 'C1_SELECTED', 'PENDING_C1_NOT_SELECTED', text()]); in_line -> rng.choice([False, True, 0, 0.285, None, '', 'x', []]); kg -> rng.choice([0.0, 0.285, 1.5]); each draw in the order written (choices whose list contains text() call text() only when chosen: rng.choice over the index first). Both hollow_cathode_elements(list) and refuse_hollow_cathode_elements('hall_icp_neutralizer', list) are evaluated per case
